title: Support group of the CI is not active
cardHint: The Support group is no longer active, so incidents on the CI reach nobody.
cardText: The Service Offering or Service Instance has a Support group, but the group is no longer active, so incidents on the CI reach nobody (procedure 2.5). A CI with no Support group at all is on the card Support group.

message.subject: Inactive Support group
message.intro: Their Support group is no longer active.
message.ask: Please raise the request {request:support-group-update} and name an active group.

askByClass.service_offering: Please raise the request {request:modify-service-offering} and name an active group.

message.why: Without an active Support group, incidents on these CIs are not assigned to a team.
